description: This file defines a driver module with functions for managing specifications, processing messages, managing crew machines, and handling emitted messages, including caching mechanisms and crew communication logic.

methods.name: GetSpec
methods.description: Retrieves and caches a specification object for a given filename.

methods.name: Process
methods.description: Processes a state and message, returning the processed result after applying a walk function.

methods.name: Match
methods.description: Performs pattern matching between a pattern and a message, returning bindings.

methods.name: SetMachine
methods.description: Adds or updates a machine in the crew with specified parameters.

methods.name: RemMachine
methods.description: Removes a machine from the crew by ID.

methods.name: CrewProcess
methods.description: Processes a message across crew machines, optionally routing to specific machines.

methods.name: CrewUpdate
methods.description: Updates crew machine states based on processed data.

methods.name: GetEmitted
methods.description: Collects emitted messages from processed steps.
